name: fl_asar
description: Extracts, inspects, and audits Electron ASAR archive packages. Verifies entry byte size integrity against header declarations, extracts package.json manifest, and maps security flags (nodeIntegration, contextIsolation, sandbox, preload).
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'inspect' (header/file list & security audit), 'extract' (unpack archive to directory). Defaults to 'inspect'.

asar_path.description: Path to the app.asar file to inspect or extract.

output_dir.description: Target directory for extraction (used when action is 'extract'). Defaults to .FL_BIN/scratch/unpacked_asar.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
